verdict.rationale: Letta's docs describe automatic in-context memory (system-prompt blocks), token-usage auditing via /doctor, and optional semantic/hybrid search via a MemFS Search mod, but none of the evidence describes a single, developer-callable API that returns a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories. missing for 10: an explicit retrieval/context-assembly endpoint or SDK call, documented token-budget parameters, and evidence of returning a ready-to-inject prompt block in one call.
